contractor_review: Fit and hinge/knob machining for the owner’s blank accompany the two white faces. Frame is square.
homeowner_estimate:
Office door replacement
I’ll fit your blank slab to the existing jamb, cut it for your hinges and knob, transfer the hardware and paint both faces white. I’ll check that it swings freely and latches. Fixed price — $390. Before booking, we’ll agree on the finish for any exposed cut edges.

contractor_review: Dimensions and sill are verified. Who supplies flashing, sealant and any missing trim stock? Keep that decision beside labor. Chicago door-install menu spans $650–1,200; exact flashing and casing terms vary. [CapaHome](https://capahome.com/services/door)
homeowner_estimate:
Front entry replacement — draft
I’ll remove the existing unit, set your prehung door in the same opening, install flashing, refit the inside and outside trim and check the swing, latch and threshold seal. You supply the unit and handle painting. Labor — $950. We’ll confirm who supplies flashing, sealant and any additional trim stock before finalizing.

contractor_review: Leak fixed; dry, sound drywall stays. Entire ceiling paint coverage confirmed.
homeowner_estimate:
Dining room ceiling
I’ll spot-prime the dry stain and paint the entire 12-by-14-foot ceiling. Fixed price — $520.

contractor_review: Confirm opening dimensions and that the electrician has released them. Their sizes affect the pending price.
homeowner_estimate:
Textured wall patching
Scope draft — pricing to follow.
Once your electrician is finished, I’ll patch four openings, match the surrounding orange-peel texture and prime the patched areas. You’ll paint the whole wall.

contractor_review: Compatible spare and four-row access confirmed. The price covers access and reassembly.
homeowner_estimate:
Gouged plank repair
I’ll shift the dresser, remove the baseboard, lift four rows from the nearest wall and replace the gouged plank with the matching spare. I’ll relay the rows, reinstall the baseboard and put the dresser back. Complete repair — $340.

contractor_review: 120 sq ft measured; subfloor and door swing checked. Keep haul and reducer in the labor package.
homeowner_estimate:
Bedroom floor replacement
I’ll remove and haul away the carpet, install 120 sq ft of your vinyl plank on the prepared floor, fit the reducer at the hall and check the door’s swing. Labor package — $720.

contractor_review: Keep the intact toilet. Check flange after lifting; broken flange requires a separately approved repair. DuPage County comparison: Keeley’s 2026 price book lists $315 for pull/reset with a new seal and no repair. Your $210 remains the homeowner price. [Provider pricing, checked November 2026](https://www.keeleysplumbing.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/2026-master-price-book.pdf) In the NW suburbs a plumber lists $190–260 for this exact reseal; DuPage lists $315. Confirm the service ZIP before calling either a city comparison. Keep $210 on the sound-flange branch.
homeowner_estimate:
Existing toilet reset
I’ll lift the toilet and inspect the flange. If it’s sound, I’ll reset your toilet with a new seal and check stability and leaks for $210. If the flange is broken, I’ll pause, show you a photograph and a separate repair quote, and wait for your approval before proceeding.

contractor_review: The wider vanity needs the owner’s plumber to move shutoffs first. The sink reconnect is your plumbing limit.
homeowner_estimate:
Wider vanity installation
After your plumber moves the shutoffs and signs off, I’ll install the new vanity, reconnect the sink and check the connection for leaks. You’ll arrange the plumber and handle wall patching. Vanity installation and sink reconnection — $450.

contractor_review: Dry joint and solid tile. Give product-specific cure time at handoff; confirm scheduling separately. The $275 Mount Prospect job also included a soap dish and mold treatment, so it is not a direct price for this seam; confirm your seam extent and make sure your $145 covers your time. [Provider pricing, checked November 2026](https://www.easyfixhandymanil.com/caulking-sealing/)
homeowner_estimate:
Tub-to-tile seam repair
I’ll remove the peeling caulk, clean the joint and recaulk the tub-to-tile seam for $145. I’ll give you the product’s cure time when I finish. Keep the seam dry until that time has passed.

contractor_review: Agreed finish is a visible paintable cover. Supplied bracket and backing are ready. A 55-inch ordinary-wall mount with a conventional supplied bracket and external strip is advertised at $135 locally. Size and mantel work can change the comparison; preserve your $220. [Provider pricing, checked November 2026](https://tvserviceschicago.com/) At 55 inches on ordinary drywall, local standard-package examples range from a conditional $135 to $317 before promotions; size, bracket and clearance still need confirmation. Retain $220.
homeowner_estimate:
TV above the mantel
I’ll mount the TV on the supplied bracket and cover its cords with a visible, paintable surface raceway to the existing outlet. Mounting and raceway — $220. Before booking, we’ll confirm the mounting height and required clearance above the fireplace.

contractor_review: Backing remains unknown. The only authorized work is the site inspection and options report. A NW suburban provider publishes $125 for a paid on-site assessment, credited toward approved work. That separate provider’s credit does not alter your $75 terms. [Provider pricing, checked November 2026](https://www.easyfixhandymanil.com/faq/)
homeowner_estimate:
Floating shelf mounting assessment
I’ll inspect the proposed mounting points for the three shelves and report the options for secure support behind the plaster. You can decide whether to proceed with installation afterward. Site check only — $75.

contractor_review: Replace both worn hinges on one door; cup hole and other doors are sound.
homeowner_estimate:
Kitchen cabinet door repair
I’ll replace both worn hinges with matching hinges and align the affected door so it closes properly. Total including parts — $105.

contractor_review: Square box and existing front stay. Match both slide length and load rating.
homeowner_estimate:
Pantry drawer repair
I’ll replace the pair of side-mount slides with slides of matching length and load rating, retain the drawer box and front, and check full travel. Fixed price — $135.

contractor_review: The existing frame is straight and the selected pet mesh is included.
homeowner_estimate:
Screen repair
I’ll rescreen the existing frame with your selected pet mesh and check its fit. Total including mesh — $95.

contractor_review: Your visit supplies measurements to the glazier. Glass replacement is a separate decision. Free glass measurements offered as part of one local glazier’s own sales estimate are a different service from your $80 standalone measurement for another glazier. [Provider pricing, checked November 2026](https://fixhomeglass.com/faq/)
homeowner_estimate:
Window glass measurement
I’ll measure the insulated glass unit and provide the dimensions for a glazier. Measurement visit only — $80.

contractor_review: Door and hinges are firm; test with existing key and door closed. One northwest-suburban shop lists $150 for door/latch alignment; this single strike adjustment is narrower. [Provider pricing, checked November 2026](https://www.northforgehome.com/services)
homeowner_estimate:
Front lock alignment
I’ll adjust the strike, check that the door latches and test the lock with your existing key. Price — $90.

contractor_review: Trim is a known length; concealed sheathing only becomes visible after removal.
homeowner_estimate:
Garage exterior trim repair
I’ll replace one 5-foot exterior trim board, prime it and paint it for $320. If removal reveals soft sheathing, I’ll stop, show you the affected area and provide a separate repair quote. I’ll wait for your approval before continuing.

contractor_review: The marked location is set. Check backing without disturbing tile; inspection fee and subsequent work remain unsettled. One NW suburban provider lists $125 for an assessment, credited toward approved work. Use that only as contractor context until you set a fee. [Provider pricing, checked November 2026](https://www.easyfixhandymanil.com/faq/)
homeowner_estimate:
Shower grab bar assessment
Scope draft — pricing to follow.
I’ll inspect the marked position without opening the tile and report what support I can verify. If backing is uncertain, we’ll discuss options. Installation would require confirmed support and your separate approval.

contractor_review: The owner’s disposal decision replaces the salvage request. The owner handles wall restoration.
homeowner_estimate:
Bathroom mirror removal
I’ll protect the area, remove the glued mirror and haul it away for disposal. You’ll handle wall patching and painting. Complete price — $225.

contractor_review: Parts and room are ready. Confirm the visit date before promising completion ahead of guests.
homeowner_estimate:
Bunk bed assembly
I’ll assemble one supplied bunk bed, anchor it as the manufacturer specifies, and flatten the cardboard in your garage. Assembly and anchoring — $190. We’ll confirm the visit date against your guests’ arrival.

contractor_review: Two existing panels stay; one guide and pivot plus adjustment and testing are included.
homeowner_estimate:
Closet door repair
I’ll replace the worn top guide and pivot, adjust the two existing panels and check that both operate properly. Complete repair — $120.

contractor_review: Five are ready now. The exchange and future visit are separate from the fixed price. The Chicago BIG Helpers menu gives $100 for two plus 3 × $25 = $175 for this five-unit visit. [Booking menu](https://square.site/book/03PHAR87WHNM0/big-helpers-inc-chicago-il)
homeowner_estimate:
Inside-mount blinds
I’ll install and check the five blinds that fit for a fixed $175. You’ll exchange the sixth. A return visit has no agreed price or date.

contractor_review: Electrician handles fixture twice; paint belongs to owner.
homeowner_estimate:
Ceiling repair around light
After your electrician removes the fixture, I’ll patch, sand and prime the ring around the opening for $185. You’ll paint the ceiling repair and your electrician will refit the fixture.

contractor_review: Measured 38 LF × $9 = $342. No removal or change provision needed. A Chicago installer’s broad new-baseboard budget is $6–10/LF; your $9 includes material and caulk. [Provider pricing, checked November 2026](https://www.landspropertycare.com/blog/flooring-installation-cost-chicago/)
homeowner_estimate:
Paint-grade baseboard
I’ll supply, cut, fit and caulk 38 linear feet of baseboard. You’ll paint it. At $9 per installed linear foot, the price for the measured run is $342.

contractor_review: One fixed visit, three accessible repairs, existing hardware and confirmed towel-ring backing.
homeowner_estimate:
Household hardware repairs
I’ll secure the cabinet pull, adjust the pantry latch and tighten the towel ring to its backing using the existing hardware. I’ll check each repair. Fixed price for all three in one visit — $165.

contractor_review: Verified ready opening/services. Complete labor, test and haul covered; owner supplies appliance. Abt’s Chicago-area price card lists $193 replacement plus $50 recycling, $243 combined for an eligible retailer installation before applicable extras. Keep your $260 package. [Provider pricing, checked November 2026](https://www.abt.com/help/local-installation)
homeowner_estimate:
Dishwasher replacement
I’ll install and secure your new dishwasher, run a cycle, check the connections for leaks, and haul away the old dishwasher. Complete price — $260.

contractor_review: Cabinet work ends at model-sized opening. Three other trades/installation responsibilities stay with owner.
homeowner_estimate:
Dishwasher opening
I’ll modify the cabinet by the sink to fit your selected dishwasher’s dimensions. Carpentry — $480. You’ll arrange the electrical work, plumbing and appliance installation.

contractor_review: Carry-in belongs to delivery crew. Existing supply/shutoff verified. No disposal.
homeowner_estimate:
Refrigerator hookup
After your delivery crew brings the refrigerator inside, I’ll level it, connect it to the existing water line and check the connection for leaks. Price — $125.

contractor_review: No gas service at range. No conversion or installation by you and no charge agreed.
homeowner_estimate:
Range conversion inquiry
The range location has no gas connection. You’ll arrange a qualified gas contractor and electrician to assess the conversion. There is no installation or charge agreed with me.

contractor_review: Paid work is the physical set/fasten only, after fabricator and electrician release fit and service.
homeowner_estimate:
Induction cooktop placement
Your counter fabricator will enlarge the opening and your electrician will handle the electrical connection. Once they confirm the opening and service are ready, I’ll set and fasten the cooktop for $160.

contractor_review: Owner selected recirculation; retire exterior vent proposal. Price covers replacement and haul. Abt’s normal microhood swap plus recycling is $139 + $38 = $177; this is retailer-eligible pricing; confirm your handling costs while preserving the agreed $240. [Provider pricing, checked November 2026](https://www.abt.com/help/local-installation)
homeowner_estimate:
Over-the-range microwave replacement
I’ll replace the microwave, configure it to recirculate air, test its operation and haul away the old unit. Complete price — $240.

contractor_review: The owner’s $200 is a ceiling, not an agreed fee. No duct route established and visit only. A NW suburban general handyman’s $125 assessment offer is a comparison only; confirm your actual fee. [Provider pricing, checked November 2026](https://www.easyfixhandymanil.com/faq/)
homeowner_estimate:
Range hood assessment
Scope draft — pricing to follow.
I’ll inspect the hood’s fit and review ventilation options with you. We’ll agree on the assessment fee before booking. Your $200 installation budget is recorded; installation is outside this visit.

contractor_review: Opening is too short. No price or installation commitment until replacement fits.
homeowner_estimate:
Wall oven fit — draft
Scope draft — pricing to follow.
You’ll exchange the oven for a model that fits the existing cabinet opening. Once we check its dimensions, we can agree on the installation scope, date and price. No cabinet alteration or installation is scheduled.
